title: Data Platform Project
summary: A data platform combining Apache Airflow, ClickHouse, Superset, and Jupyter notebooks to generate, load, and visualize synthetic data with geospatial references. One notebook, CGAN.ipynb, uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic tabular data for the pipeline.
evidence: data (csv and ipynb)/CGAN.ipynb:11-92 imports CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata, then trains model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata, epochs=200)
